title: UNDP promotes comprehensive access to justice in Yemen
summary: The UNDP is working to strengthen communities in Yemen to achieve better access to the justice system, ensuring that legal services are reachable and fair for all, including marginalized groups.
body:
The UNDP is working to strengthen communities in Yemen to achieve better access to the justice system, ensuring that legal services are reachable and fair for all, including marginalized groups.
